source_files: https://huggingface.co/datasets/DogNeverSleep/EgoBlind/resolve/main/Video/video_part_aa (zip members 00000.mp4, 00002.mp4, stream-inflated from the first ~110 MB)
note: An example is one clip filmed by a blind creator with all its train.csv rows: each row is a question the wearer needs answered at 'start-time/s' (only video before that moment may be used), 1-4 human reference answers, and a question type. Timeline shows each question (type in brackets) followed by its reference answers at the same timestamp; answers are alternatives, not a dialogue. Video 0's clip covers 36.0-54.3 s; its tool-use question at 6.99 s and 22.98 s fall outside the clip.

examples.title: Video 0: blind passenger in a car's back seat — 5 questions (tool use, navigation, safety)

timeline.text: [tool use] How do I adjust the seatbelt?
You need to pull the belt from the side of your seat and click it into the buckle.
It's on the buttom left or right of where you are sitting.
The seat belt may be on your upper left, you can pull it to the lower right and insert it into the buckle.
[tool use] How do I lower or raise the window?
Use the window control button on the car door.
The door on your left has a press or rocker operation.
You can ask the driver for help.
[communication and interaction] Is the driver looking at me or facing forward?
The driver is facing forward.
Facing forward.
He is facing forward.
[local navigation and positioning] Which direction will I need to move to exit the vehicle?
Left.
Usually you can't open the door on the left, you you have to try the left first, then the right.
You're closer to the left door, but it will be safer if you exit from the right door.
[safety warnings] Is everything secure inside the car?
Yes.

examples.title: Video 2: crossing a street between parked bikes — 5 questions incl. 'Is it safe to cross the street now?'

Walk slower, the width a person can walk is only the width of their shoulders.

[safety warnings] Is it safe to cross the street now?
